controller_notes.SDMMC_SLOT0/SDMMC_SLOT1: one S3 SD/MMC host exposes slot 0 up to 8-bit and slot 1 up to 4-bit through the GPIO matrix; two 4-bit links remain one scheduled-controller concurrency gate
controller_notes.I2C1_OR_UART0_OR_GPIO: historical candidates only: GPIO7/8 use the S3 second hardware I2C controller, UART0 through the GPIO matrix or custom GPIO as one mutually exclusive Unit profile
